info.name: Full Text Search - PostgreSQL
info.summary: PostgreSQL platform for Full Text Search
info.description:
Index and search your Nextcloud using PostgreSQL's native full-text search capabilities.
This app provides a PostgreSQL-based search platform for the Full Text Search framework, offering: - Native PostgreSQL full-text search with ts_vector - Trigram similarity for fuzzy matching - Multi-language support - Lower resource footprint than Elasticsearch - No additional infrastructure required if already using PostgreSQL
Perfect for small to medium Nextcloud instances that want powerful search without the complexity of Elasticsearch.
